paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 6.4, with a change of -3.03% compared to the prior close and 2.4% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 14, 2026.

There are also reports of the company receiving a US subpoena tied to Project Matador and submitting its Q2 2026 SEC 10-Q report, which highlights corporate conversion and Project Matador risks.

There have been several recent SEC filings, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of a new Chief Executive Officer, Lee McIntire, with an annualized base salary of $750,000.
